recipe.visualDefinition: A centered full-body portrait of a man in stark white clothing standing in front of a weathered 1970s sedan in a desert scrubland under a dramatic, cloud-heavy twilight sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical subject bisecting a horizontal vehicle
High-contrast white clothing against muted earth tones
Symmetry between left and right typographic placement
Warm horizon glow contrasting with cool blue-grey storm clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, full-body, occupying the middle third of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's white trousers and tank top provide the primary high-value focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure, moves outward to the car's profile, then to the text on the left and right horizons.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and foreground scrubland create a sense of isolation and scale.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted tan and ochre (ground) and slate blue (sky).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (clothing) creates a sharp break from the environment.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft peach/pink at the horizon line.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment allows the high-value white subject to pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or single-weight sans-serif used symmetrically.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment with the car's roofline

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure with modern feel
Open geometric forms suitable for wide tracking

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide shot of a man in a white tank top and white trousers standing centered in front of a side-profile 1970s brown sedan. The setting is a dry desert at dusk with low scrub brush. The sky is filled with heavy, dark blue-grey clouds with a sliver of orange-pink sunset at the horizon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two strings of text in a light geometric sans-serif, all-caps, with very wide tracking. Place one string on the far left and the other on the far right, aligned horizontally with the car's windows.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking sufficiently wide?
Is the car weathered and matte?
Does the sky have a distinct color gradient from horizon to top?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the man's white clothes are the brightest element.
Check that the car does not look brand new.
Verify the text is legible but small and airy.
Confirm the horizon line is straight.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure + horizontal vehicle + wide-tracked sans-serif + twilight desert palette.
